upper_wick_group.name: Upper Wick Group
upper_wick_group.comment: upper_wick_group = compare(upper_wick, prev_upper_wick) = Increase | Not Increase

vol_high_pattern.name: Volume and High Behavior Pattern
vol_high_pattern.comment: vol_high_pattern = compare(Volume, vol_lag1) + compare(High, high_lag1) = VolUp_HighUp | VolUp_HighDown | VolDown_HighUp | VolDown_HighDown

ibs_volume_pattern.name: IBS and Volume Behavior Pattern
ibs_volume_pattern.comment: ibs_volume_group = compare(Volume, vol_lag1) + compare(IBS, ibs_lag1) = VolUp_IBSUp | VolUp_IBSDown | VolDown_IBSUp | VolDown_IBSDown

high_rsi_pattern.name: High & RSI Pattern
high_rsi_pattern.comment: high_rsi_pattern = compare(High, high_lag1) + compare(RSI, rsi_lag1) = HighUp_RSIUp | HighUp_RSIDown | HighDown_RSIUp | HighDown_RSIDown

equal_low.name: Equal Low
equal_low.comment: Low is approximately equal to low_lag1 within 0.1 percent of Close

equal_high.name: Equal High
equal_high.comment: High is approximately equal to high_lag1 within 0.1 percent of Close

inside_bar_prev.name: Previous Inside Bar
inside_bar_prev.comment: Previous bar high-low range is inside the bar before it

is_max_4.name: Is Max High in 4 Bars
is_max_4.comment: High is higher than the max High of the previous 3 bars

is_max_10.name: Is 10-Bar High Maximum
is_max_10.comment: True if High is greater than maximum High of previous 9 bars

is_min_10.name: Is 10-Bar Low Minimum
is_min_10.comment: True if Low is less than minimum Low of previous 9 bars

close_price_group.name: Close Price Position Group
close_price_group.comment: > prev High | Bong nen tren | Than nen | Bong nen duoi | < prev Low

open_price_group.name: Open Price Position Group
open_price_group.comment: Open > prev_Close | Open = prev_Close | Open < prev_Close

ibs_vol_group.name: IBS Volume Combination Group
ibs_vol_group.comment: Vol up, ibs incre | Vol up, ibs decr | Vol down, ibs incre | Vol down, ibs decr

long_trend.name: Long Trend
long_trend.comment: StrongUp | StrongDown = EMA_1month > EMA_6months | EMA_1month < EMA_6months
